items.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake series coming to Final Fantasy XIV
items.summary: In case you missed my previous post around the keynote address, Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest is underway in Berlin. I posted a lot of the updates in that
items.content:
In case you missed my previous post around the keynote address, Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest is underway in Berlin. I posted a lot of the updates in that previous post, but one was so big I had to post about it separately, regardless of how big they may be to other people. In the latter half of the keynote, Naoki Yoshida revealed the theme of the 8-player raid coming with Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold. This is, of course, different from the 24-player, which we know will be based on anime property Evangelion, and is following the triumph that was the Arcadion.

With the name Beyond the Lifestream, this next series will be a crossover with the Final Fantasy VII Remake series. The moment was marked by the introduction of the Director of the series, Naoki Hamaguchi to the stage. The information was scant, as you would expect, from a reveal that we aren’t going to even see until the mid-to-tail end of the year. But there were several teases of what characters might appear and what scenarios will be faced in an open and friendly conversation between the two Naokis on the stage.

What we do know at this point is that it will start releasing as of Patch 8.01 and will follow the usual three-tier system. So that will mean 12 raids of increasing difficulty against what we could assume will be a selection of iconic bosses from the Remake series. Speaking of difficulty too, this raid series will have the previously revealed third difficulty as well, with the new difficulty fitting between Normal and Savage. Also, the story and art direction of the raids are being overseen by the Remake series team, with Tetsuya Nomura obviously stepping in for the latter.

That wasn’t all though, as Naoki Yoshida revealed a new attraction coming to the Gold Saucer. For some baffling, but certainly not unwelcome, reason … this will be a typing mini-game. Called Keybound Brawler, the first iteration will be Final Fantasy VII themed, allowing up to four players to tackle an array of typing challenges. This is confirmed to draw upon knowledge of the games, with specific words related to the games and has Barrett and Tifa glamour items as rewards. This will launch on 28 th October 2026 as part of Patch 7.56.

If anything, this gives me more of a reason to finally finish Final Fantasy VII: Rebirth, and it definitely hits the right note with the release next Spring of the third game in the trilogy. To be honest, as long as all this results in more glamour options, and maybe some weapons, I’m all on board. But what do you think about the Final Fantasy VII Remake series coming to Final Fantasy XIV?

items.title: New Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Details Shared At Berlin Fanfest
Start Deleting Stuff, Because Final Fantasy XIV Will Be the Largest Switch 2 Game Ever
items.summary: Nintendo Switch 2 owners will need to start deleting games, as Final Fantasy XIV is set to be the biggest title on the system in terms of file size.
items.content:
Start Deleting Stuff, Because Final Fantasy XIV Will Be the Largest Switch 2 Game Ever From DualShockers (Written by Scott Baird) on July 26, 2026 | OpenCritic

Final Fantasy XIV is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in August, and fans had better start deleting games now, as the file size for Eorzea and beyond will make it one of the biggest on the system and will only grow larger over time.

The Nintendo Switch 2 is technically advanced enough to handle the modern Final Fantasy games, which means titles like Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will launch day-one on the platform . The problem is that recent Square Enix titles tend to have massive file sizes, usually clocking in at over 100 GB, owing to their triple-A quality visuals eating up storage space.

Square Enix announced at Final Fantasy XIV Berlin Fan Festival that the Nintendo Switch 2 version will launch on August 4, 2026. Those who are eager to go on a portable journey to Eorzea will have to start planning their storage space, as Stealth40k has claimed on Twitter/X that the Switch 2 port of Final Fantasy XIV will take up around 117 GB, which is nearly half of what the system can handle.

Final Fantasy XIV Is Nearly 120 GB On Switch 2 (And Counting)

items.title: Bastion Is The First New Job In Final Fantasy XIV Evercold, A Dual-Greatshield Tank
items.summary: Square Enix has revealed the first of two new jobs coming to Final Fantasy XIV's sixth expansion, Evercold, and it is a tank unlike anything the game has fielded before. Bastion is a main tank that fights with a pair of greatshields called skyltborg, and producer and director Naoki Yoshida unveiled ...
items.content:
Gaming Bastion Is The First New Job In Final Fantasy XIV Evercold, A Dual-Greatshield Tank GameDaily Follow Franz Christian Irorita Sun, July 26, 2026 at 5:05 AM UTC Add us on Google Sun, July 26, 2026 at 5:05 AM UTC Bastion Is The First New Job In Final Fantasy XIV Evercold, A Dual-Greatshield Tank Square Enix has revealed the first of two new jobs coming to Final Fantasy XIV 's sixth expansion, Evercold , and it is a tank unlike anything the game has fielded before. Bastion is a main tank that fights with a pair of greatshields called skyltborg, and producer and director Naoki Yoshida unveiled it during the Fan Festival 2026 keynote in Berlin , taking the stage in the job's full armor to do it.

Rather than a single sword-and-board setup, Bastion wields two oversized shields that shift between configurations, striking foes up close in one mode and firing in another, a blend of high fantasy and heavy machinery that matches the Norse-flavored world of the Fourth where Evercold takes place. Keynote reports indicate the job starts at Level 90 through a quest in Limsa Lominsa, in line with how recent jobs have been introduced.

Bastion also arrives alongside a broader shake-up for tanks. Square Enix is condensing tank combos and formalizing Main Tank and Off Tank roles, and Bastion slots in next to Paladin on the Main Tank side. That makes the reveal as much about where the tank role is heading as it is about one new job.

The second job has been confirmed as a physical ranged DPS but was not shown in Berlin. With three year-long Fan Festivals on the calendar, that reveal is expected when the Tokyo event closes out the run on October 31, 2026. Bastion is the tank piece of a two-job expansion, and it opens the Godless Realms Saga when Evercold launches in January 2027.

For the full picture of the expansion, including its setting, systems overhaul, and crossover raids, see our Evercold everything-you-need-to-know guide, and for how we got here, our coverage of the original Evercold reveal in April .

This story was originally published by GameDaily on Jul 26, 2026, where it first appeared in the Games section. Add GameDaily as a Preferred Source by clicking here.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV comes to Switch 2 Aug. 4th, 2026, new Evercold trailers shared
items.content:
0 Square Enix recently announced that Final Fantasy XIV is coming to Switch 2 in August 2026. Now we have an official release date for the Switch 2 version, and it’s not far away: August 4th, 2026. The game will require a subscription fee (as it does on other platforms), but Switch Online won’t be necessary to play. You can see all the details now on the Switch eShop . You may want to clear some space out now, because this one will be 117GB at launch on Switch 2.

In addition, we know that Switch 2 will be getting the new Evercold expansion when it launches in January 2027. Today we have multiple new looks at the Evercold content. You can see an extended teaser trailer above to get a broad overview. Check out the bottom of this post for more in depth looks at brand new areas to explore, the new Bastion class, and the upcoming collab with Evangelion.

items.title: FFXIV Evercold's new tank class Bastion is a big first for Final Fantasy
items.summary: Forget Gunbreakers. We've got Gunshields now
items.content:
By Josh Broadwell Published Jul 25, 2026, 11:39 AM EDT News Forget Gunbreakers. We've got Gunshields now

Image: Square Enix Square Enix producer Naoki Yoshida revealed Bastion, Final Fantasy 14 Evercold 's new tank class, during Fan Fest Berlin on Saturday, and it's a pretty big deal for Final Fantasy. Bastion is a main tank, a term introduced as part of FF14 's new "evolved" combat system that designates a tank as defense- and offense-oriented, rather than support-minded. And it's also the first brand-new class unassociated with any previous Final Fantasy job in FF14 .

The Bastion wields two special shields called Skyltborg, models of which Yoshida brought on stage during the address while wearing full Bastion garb (and quickly discarded thanks to their weight). These heavy shields represent a tradition of martial training on The Fourth ( Evercold 's setting) that stretches back generations, originating in a northern archipelago and passed down to those who dedicated their lives to protecting the realm. They're not just big shields, though. The Bastion's shields are shape-changing, aether-powered turrets that function as defensive devices and artillery units.

"Main tank" might mean defense first, but the Bastion does pretty much everything. Yoshida played a brief trailer showing the Bastion in action against one of Evercold 's big new enemies. The trailer showed no skill names, but you can see the Bastion going through several ability chains: One that creates a magic shield around the player, another that fires off aether-charged shots from a distance after charging for a few levels, a skill that makes the earth quake under an enemy, and an up-close melee combo chain. The Bastion also gets a set of "curative boons," though the trailer didn't show any of those.

Square Enix isn't in the habit of making new job roles in any Final Fantasy game, so Bastion is kind of a big deal. Even spinoffs like Brave Exvius (soon to be Final Fantasy Resonance ) repurpose older roles like FF12 's Green Mage and the Spellblade from FF5 . That's the philosophy Square Enix previously adopted with FF14 as well. Prior to Evercold , all of FF14 's job classes had ties to established roles in previous Final Fantasy games — obvious ones like Red Mage and Bard and some slightly more obscure references, like Reaper being a nod to Sice from Final Fantasy Type-0 and Final Fantasy 11 's scythe-wielding Dark Knight. Bastion has no such reference point. It's a totally fresh class designed with Evercold 's Evolved Combat in mind.

items.content:
by Donald Theriault - July 25, 2026, 11:31 am EDT Discuss in talkback! Source: Square Enix

At least Square can't put THIS on a Game Key Card... oh crap, they just quoted Pierre Trudeau. ("Just watch me.")

It turns out Final Fantasy XIV will arrive on Switch 2 early in August.

As part of a fan festival in Germany for the popular MMO, it was confirmed that the Switch 2 version of Final Fantasy XIV would go live on August 4. The game's eShop listing confirms a file size of 117 GB, though it cannot be downloaded yet: monthly subscriptions will be required following a roughly 1 month trial period.

items.content:
In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll through Windurst: The Third Walk in the FINAL FANTASY XI alliance raid crossover, and leap into battle in Archeia Harmonias, an all-new arena for Crystalline Conflict. A host of other additions and adjustments will make your time in Eorzea more streamlined and enjoyable, including increased furnishing placement limits, the consolidation of dyes, and additional pieces of gear that can now be converted to outfit glamour or stored in the armoire. With the introduction of Patch 7.5, the Shadowbringers expansion can now be played as part of the FINAL FANTASY XIV Starter Edition. The expansion will be automatically registered to your account if you already own the Starter Edition, so why not take this opportunity to jump into the adventure?

If you or any of your friends are currently taking a break from your adventures, you won't want to miss out on this limited-time event! Visit the Free Login Campaign website for details.
